title: The five GavickPro (Gavern) quickstarts wear a design system from their tokenized 1.0.1 re-releases: each gk_* template maps to its ready slot contract, a site built from 1.0.0 is asked to update, and a Gavern contract that opts in breaks long heading words
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap packages/design/tracy-ds-slot/test/cms.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/design-system-door.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of each test named below.
expect: 'Joomla: a Gavern (GavickPro) contract breaks long heading words only when it opts in (breakWords)' passes.

'a template maps to its slot contract; one without a contract says why' passes (gk_appetit, gk_archi, gk_compact, gk_restly, gk_spotlight map to joomla-gk-*; a gk_appetit site at quickstart 1.0.0 answers TEMPLATE_NEEDS_UPDATE, need 1.0.1).
'every ready contract names the releases it wears' passes (each joomla-gk-* contract carries minVersion quickstart/gavick-gk-<name>/j6 = 1.0.1).
fence: Which GavickPro template element maps to which slot contract, its readiness and minVersion; the opt-in breakWords rule. No stand, no model, no Docker.

tests: Joomla: a Gavern (GavickPro) contract breaks long heading words only when it opts in (breakWords)
a template maps to its slot contract; one without a contract says why
every ready contract names the releases it wears
